bibl.title: The Papyrological Rediscovery of the Monastery of Apa Ezekiel and Bishop Andrew of Hermonthis (6th Century). Preliminary Report on the Edition of the Coptic Ostraca at the Leipzig University Library.
bibl.seg: 142.13 O. Lips. Inv. 3325; 3326; 3548 145.13 O. Lond. Copt. I, pl. LXIII 3 O. Vind. Copt. 288

Frederic Krueger, The Papyrological Rediscovery of the Monastery of Apa Ezekiel and Bishop Andrew of Hermonthis (6th Century). Preliminary Report on the Edition of the Coptic Ostraca at the Leipzig University Library.
bibl.note: 1. "Provenance: Theban region" - A problematic category. - 2. The Theban region beyond Thebes: Research lacunae and methodological issues obscuring bishops and monasteries of Hermonthis before the year 600. - 3. Establishing Apa Aron and Apa Andrew as abbots of the Topos of Apa Ezekiel [edition of O. Lips. Inv. 3548 (that will be published as O. Lips. Copt. II, 83) and reedition of O. Vind. Copt. 288]. - 4. The Well and the Waterwheel: Possible Coptic and Arabic synonyms for the Topos of Apa Ezekiel and the problem of its localization [with a reedition of O. Lond. Copt. I, pl. LXIII 3]. - 5. The 6th century: Relations with the first monastery of Phoibammon, the beginnings of the monophysite church in Egypt, and Apa Andrew's role as "father of all the monks in all the land" [edition of O. Lips. Inv. 3348 (= O. Lips. Copt. II, 375) and Inv. 3326 (= O. Lips. Copt. II, 10)]. - 6. Conclusion.
